title: Pool Prognostics Panel & Burst Lab — composable GPU pool controls and live health signals
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design a new console surface for Dedicated GPU pools that combines predictive health signals, composable autoscale knobs, and an interactive "Burst Lab" for safely tuning short-term capacity spikes. The goal is to give SREs and platform engineers fast, actionable visibility (latency SLO breaches, queue depth, cache hit rates, billing slope) alongside a set of guarded controls for burst sizing, cooldowns, and fallback routes. This ticket covers: 1) low-fidelity flows and a mid-fidelity prototype showing data-driven states; 2) component spec for the Prognostics ribbon (trend + anomaly badges); 3) Burst Lab micro-interaction patterns (simulate, preview cost delta, run temporary commit); 4) accessibility and responsive layout considerations for narrow ops screens. Deliverables: Figma prototype, component tokens, interaction brief for ENG, and usability test summary.
